analysis_plan.data: GSE111554 (blood) + GSE111552 (PBMC), mismo estudio 18wk running, vo2peak pre/post por sujeto

author: ichor
note: Kill criterion: rho<0.2 en ambos blood sets (pre-registrado). GSE111553 (blood G1) no trae vo2peak en series matrix -> no testeable. GSE111551 (muscle) fuera de alcance blood.
primary_hypothesis: Pre-training expression of the training-attenuated module (dip-score-selected genes) predicts VO2max change after endurance intervention
question: Does the FME (exercise-attenuated gene module, from GSE324210) distinguish responders from non-responders at baseline?
verdict: KILL CONFIRMADO en 2 sets independientes (blood + PBMC). La expresion pre-training del modulo blunting no predice respuesta VO2max. FME sub-hypothesis dead at blood baseline (2/2 sets).
